definition: Any node of the style taxonomy, at any rank from a tradition down to a buildable variant. Each but a tradition is filed under a single parent for browsing, and may descend from several ancestors at once.
basis: schema/style-node.schema.json: "A single taxon in the Traditional Design Language style graph." Nodes form a directed acyclic graph of lineage and "a separate strict single-parent containment hierarchy via member_of", where "a family's is its tradition. Null only for traditions". docs/model.md: "Multiple parents are normal."
analogy: Borrowed from biology, where a species and a genus are both taxa, at different ranks.
